description: 🎨 Open-source AI slide studio inside Codex: image-native decks, every slide a full visual canvas. ⚡ 10+ high-quality slides in ~4–5 minutes — Fast mode renders every page in parallel. 🔍 Watch the whole chain live: research → outline → style → render → edit → present → export PDF/PPTX. 🖥️ Browser-first · zero API keys · durable projects.
